title: Media Caption & Credit Policy Compiler
description: Compiles the media caption and credit attribution policy. Enforces: every media type declares caption and credit requirements, credit format template defined, template variables are valid, externally sourced media requires a license declaration, attribution placement declared, and expiry monitoring set for time-limited rights.

error_codes.MCP001: media-caption-credit-policy.json missing or invalid — required fields: media_types[] with caption_required, credit_required
error_codes.MCP002: Media type missing caption_required or credit_required declaration — both must be explicitly declared per media type
error_codes.MCP003: Credit format template not defined for media type requiring credit — declare a credit template string with named variables
error_codes.MCP004: Credit format template contains undefined variable — all {variable} placeholders must be declared in the variables list
error_codes.MCP005: Externally sourced media type missing license declaration requirement — all external media must require a license field
error_codes.MCP006: Attribution placement not declared — specify: inline | footer | metadata-only for each media type
error_codes.MCP007: Expiry monitoring not set for time-limited licensed media — licensed assets with expiry dates must have monitoring enabled
